query:
-- Check all users with staff roles
SELECT id, name, email, role, createdAt 
FROM users 
WHERE role IN ('super_admin', 'admin', 'employee', 'accountant')
ORDER BY role, name
LIMIT 50;

-- Count by role
SELECT role, COUNT(*) as count
FROM users
GROUP BY role
ORDER BY role;
